info.title: Temporary v2 workspace viewer
info.description: Read-only views of an Agent checkout and of its turn deliveries that v2-server serves outside api/openapi.json; candidates for Cloud.

get.summary: List one directory of the checkout (the conversation's checkout)

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Path relative to the checkout, with forward slashes; empty or omitted is the root

parameters.name: path

parameters.name: path

parameters.name: deliveryId
parameters.description: Pin the diff to this good delivery of the same source

code.description: workspace_not_ready (no checkout yet), workspace_removed, invalid_path, path_not_found, not_a_directory, not_a_file, binary_file, too_large, not_found, workflow_run_not_found, execution_unavailable, workspace_unavailable (mirror or delivery ref unreadable), invalid_delivery_id, delivery_not_found, delivery_failed (params reasonCode, reason), patch_too_large (params message, maxBytes), internal

patch.description: Unified diff of this file; empty when it is unchanged

WorkspaceDelivery.description: One turn delivery. nodeId and nodeRunId occur together, for workflow runs only; deliveryCommit only for delivered; reasonCode and reason only for failed.

WorkspaceDeliveryState.description: What the change view shows. mode working_directory: a source from before deliveries, read live. mode delivery: viewDelivery is the good delivery rendered (absent before the first one), latestDelivery the newest outcome including failed, latestFailedDelivery the newest failure; inProgress while a turn of the source runs or is being delivered.
